## Change

Describe the problem and the behavior that changes. Link the issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results. For game changes, include the
version, environment, mode and tested cases. Distinguish completed checks
from those still pending.

## Compatibility and limitations

Where relevant, explain the effect on player saves, game data, the network
protocol and determinism. Do not include ISOs, extracted game data,
credentials or player saves.
